## Purpose

Describe the mission, game-loop, coaching, or product-quality improvement and why it matters.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run skill:validate`
- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run smoke`
- [ ] `npm run check`

## Public-content checklist

- [ ] No customer data, credentials, personal data, private prompts, or unreleased product information.
- [ ] Product claims use official UiPath sources and preserve GA/Preview status.
- [ ] Tests and public documentation are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] The contribution can be distributed under the MIT License.
